name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Stand beside a wall or chair, touch it lightly for balance and lift one foot clear.
Keep your standing knee straight with just a tiny unlock and brace your core.
Press through the ball of your standing foot to lift your heel as high as possible, squeezing your calf firmly at the top.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor, and switch legs after finishing one side.
tips: Push evenly through the ball of your foot without rolling out toward your little toe.
Avoid bouncing quickly at the bottom; pause briefly on the floor between repetitions.
